_about: Tiered referral paths into target companies across all three source files (seen_jobs.json, browser_finds.json, warmode_leads.json). Discovery only — no outreach performed. Use to decide who to ask for an intro before applying or pitching.

_tiers.tier1_email: AJ's direct Gmail. A real path = human, two-way correspondence with someone at the company.
_tiers.tier2_linkedin: AJ's 1st-degree LinkedIn connections. 'current_employees' = work there now (strongest). 'connectors' = investors/advisors/ex-employees who can broker an intro. Prioritized by influence (mutual-connection count + follower count) per AJ's request.
_tiers.tier3_coach_dashboard: Upward Product Management referral network (https://referrals.upwardproductmanagement.com/). Number = in-network people who list that company and can refer. Log in to see names.

_method_caveats: Tier 1: searched by company email domain (sent + received). Result was conclusive across the priority set — see summary.

Tier 2: LinkedIn people search filtered to 1st-degree, keyword = company name. Reliable for distinctive names (OpenAI, Brex, Anthropic, ClassDojo); UNRELIABLE for common-word names (Mercury, Suno, Close, Ramp, Cursor, Harvey, Salient) which need a company-ID facet pass — those are listed under tier2_pending.
Tier 2 profile URLs not captured (search text only) — names + headlines + mutual-count are enough to locate each person.
Tier 3 captured in one client-side pass over the dashboard; counts are company-level.

summary.tier1_email_finding: NO warm email paths. AJ has never emailed a human at any priority company; all mail is transactional (noreply@, invoice@, billing@, support@, newsletters like Robinhood Snacks). Email is not a viable referral channel for these targets.
tier2_strongest: OpenAI — Terri Wang (Growth @ OpenAI) and Jeremy Schwartz (Growth for Codex) are 1st-degree connections ON the growth team AJ reached the final round with; Ibrahim Okuyucu (ex-Head of Growth Engineering, 11K followers) also 1st-degree.
Brex — Art Levy (Chief Business Officer, current) and Sarah Pike (GTM People Partner, current) are 1st-degree.
